Connor Bedard to Make Season Debut for Chicago Blackhawks

Connor Bedard is expected to make his season debut for the Chicago Blackhawks in a game against Sidney Crosby and the Pittsburgh Penguins. His return is anticipated to help the team, which has a 1-5-0 record, though questions remain about whether it will fully resolve their issues.
